title: Driver Hub deployment input declaration v2
description: Structural rules of driver-config.json schemaVersion 2: v1 plus the per-input value constraints url and enum. Driver Hub releases older than version 2 support refuse it. Cross-field rules (those of v1, enum choices within the length bounds, defaults that satisfy enum and url) and the value rules are checked by tools/validate-driver.py. See Drivers/RELEASING.md#declaration-schemaversion-2.

controlHealth.description: HTTP endpoint Driver Hub polls as the driver-communication check. 2xx means the authenticated VideoIPath session is established.

nodeIdInput.description: Input that carries the node ID when it is not bound to VIDEOIPATH_NODE_ID. Must name a non-secret string input without a default.

videoIPathInputs.description: Inputs that carry the VideoIPath endpoint and token when they are not bound to VIDEOIPATH_URL and VIDEOIPATH_TOKEN.

description.description: Shown to operators as the input's hint.

file.description: Absolute container path, mounted read-only. No . or .. segments.

enum.description: The only values the driver accepts, compared exactly and case-sensitively. Non-secret strings only.

allOf.description: An input is either an enumeration or a URL.

urlConstraint.description: The value is an absolute URL in the canonical form described in Drivers/RELEASING.md#url-values, with one of the schemes and, when path is given, exactly that path. Every key except path is required: there are no implied defaults.

schemes.description: Accepted schemes, written in lowercase. A value's scheme is compared case-insensitively.

path.description: The exact path, compared character for character. Omit to accept any path. No dot segments (also not as %2E) and percent-escapes in uppercase hex.

allowCredentials.description: Whether the authority may contain userinfo: anything before an @, even if empty.

allowQuery.description: Whether the value may contain ?, even with an empty query.

allowFragment.description: Whether the value may contain #, even with an empty fragment.
